# ECN-2026-026 Change notice - Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P3 (plant)  
Line: P3-L4 (line)  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-SB03 (equipment)

Related documents: MM-P3-L4-SB03, SOP-P3-L4-03, SOP-P3-L4-05

Reason for change
- Background: Preventative maintenance and production feedback identified accelerated wear and lubricant contamination pathways in Heat Treat shot blast cabinet number three, EQ-P3-L4-SB03. Inspection findings and maintenance records showed recurrent bearing and seal degradation linked to lubricant selection and application practice. The change clarifies the approved lubricant, updates lubrication application method, and formalizes records and verification steps to reduce unscheduled downtime and extend component life.
- Root cause summary: Investigation determined the existing field-applied lubricants in use were inconsistent with vendor recommendations for the cabinet drive bearings and were permitting airborne media carryover into lubrication points. Additionally, application practice did not ensure complete coverage of serviceable points and left residue that trapped abrasive material. Corrective action requires a controlled lubricant specification, revised lubrication procedure, and verification by maintenance checks described here.
- Objective: Standardize lubricant to CFW-LUB-526 (part number) for all lubrication points specified for EQ-P3-L4-SB03, update relevant SOPs, and implement inspection and recording steps to demonstrate compliance and efficacy.

Affected items
- Equipment scope: EQ-P3-L4-SB03 main turbine blast wheel bearings, pivot points, and accessible gear interfaces that currently accept non-sealed grease fittings as identified in MM-P3-L4-SB03.
- Documentation: This ECN modifies maintenance and operations practice by directing amendments to MM-P3-L4-SB03 and the following operating procedures: SOP-P3-L4-03 and SOP-P3-L4-05. These documents shall be updated to reference CFW-LUB-526 (part number) and the new application method.
- Consumables: All future purchases and on-site spares for lubricants to be listed and stocked as CFW-LUB-526 (part number). Existing stocks not labeled as CFW-LUB-526 must be quarantined and dispositioned per stores policy prior to their use on EQ-P3-L4-SB03.
- Personnel: Maintenance technicians assigned to EQ-P3-L4-SB03 and shift leads in P3-L4 shall be trained on the revised SOP content and sign acknowledgement forms retained with the maintenance records.

Implementation
- Specification change: Effective upon approval of this ECN, CFW-LUB-526 (part number) is the only approved lubricant for the specified lubrication points on EQ-P3-L4-SB03. Procurement, stores, and maintenance supervisors will update master parts lists and work orders to reflect this change.
- Procedure revision: Update SOP-P3-L4-03 and SOP-P3-L4-05 to include:
  - Explicit identification of each lubrication point on EQ-P3-L4-SB03 and the recommended application quantity phraseology for technicians.
  - Pre-application cleaning steps to remove trapped abrasive material and old lubricant residues.
  - Acceptance criteria for completed lubrication (visual and tactile).
  - Use of clean dispensing tools and dedicated application containers to minimize contamination risk.
  - Steps for returning replaced parts to inspection when required by MM-P3-L4-SB03.
- Training and roll-out: Conduct a training session for maintenance and operations staff on the revisions to SOP-P3-L4-03 and SOP-P3-L4-05 and on the handling and application of CFW-LUB-526 (part number). Attendance rosters and signed acknowledgements will be retained by the maintenance supervisor.
- Example application scenario: During scheduled preventive maintenance for EQ-P3-L4-SB03, technicians shall:
  - Isolate the cabinet, follow lockout procedures, and remove guards to expose lubrication points.
  - Clean each fitting area per the revised SOP, apply CFW-LUB-526 (part number) using a clean dispenser, wipe excess, and record completion in the maintenance log as specified by MM-P3-L4-SB03.
  - Where evidence of media intrusion is found, document as a nonconformance and follow corrective steps in MM-P3-L4-SB03 before returning the equipment to service.
- Verification and monitoring: Post-implementation, maintenance leadership will perform verification audits of lubrication logs and physical inspections on EQ-P3-L4-SB03. Audit frequency and specific checklist items will be appended to MM-P3-L4-SB03 to ensure consistent verification against the new standard.
- Inventory control: Stores will flag existing lubricant inventory that does not match CFW-LUB-526 (part number) and will not release nonconforming items for use on EQ-P3-L4-SB03. A reconciliation record of existing stocks shall be maintained and attached to the purchase order history.

Records to keep
- Updated MM-P3-L4-SB03, SOP-P3-L4-03, and SOP-P3-L4-05, with revision notes indicating this ECN.
- Training attendance rosters and signed acknowledgement forms for personnel trained on the new lubricant and procedures.
- Maintenance work orders and lubrication logs for EQ-P3-L4-SB03 showing lubricant used, technician name, and visual acceptance checks.
- Inventory disposition records for replaced or quarantined lubricant stocks that do not match CFW-LUB-526 (part number).
- Verification audit checklists and findings tied to MM-P3-L4-SB03, including any corrective actions taken.

Approvals
- Maintenance Manager: Review and approve the specification change to require CFW-LUB-526 (part number) for EQ-P3-L4-SB03 and authorize updates to MM-P3-L4-SB03.
- Operations Manager: Approve changes to SOP-P3-L4-03 and SOP-P3-L4-05 and confirm training requirement for operations personnel assigned to P3-L4.
- Stores Supervisor: Acknowledge responsibility to control inventory and enforce the use of CFW-LUB-526 (part number) for EQ-P3-L4-SB03.
- Quality Assurance: Approve the verification and audit plan and accept the record retention locations for training and maintenance logs.

Revision note
- This is Revision Rev D of the ECN. Implement changes across documentation identified in MM-P3-L4-SB03, SOP-P3-L4-03, and SOP-P3-L4-05 and maintain traceability of approvals and records as outlined above.
